scope: 2022 statistical calibration and paired development only; U exploratory following failed original A2
models: Exact frozen 2021 T-P and U-P from approved bound original run; no refit
continuous_calibration_context: Source 18-31 December 2021, 336 scheduled hours, unscored; source 1 January-31 December 2022 scored for ready coverage/order statistic; HH24 retains source-month ownership
development_context: Full source month; January begins day 2 as C1. Exactly 14 strictly earlier source days of unscored context, including accepted late-2021 context where required. Each pair starts at zero at context start; no month/intervention resets inside the window.
gap_rule: Hold through six unavailable scheduled hours; reset count/state on seventh; no P-to-S substitution
cutoff: One-based ceil((1-alpha)*n) of absolute ready 2022 states only. Decimal alpha evaluated as exact fraction for index. n>0, finite cutoff>0; strict exceedance.
development: 216 cases per variable per eligible lambda: 12 months, signs -1/+1, amplitudes .5/1/2 frozen scales, ramps 24/72/168 plus equal hold. Day 8 HH01 start; missing hours never compressed. Full month/context both replays; save every intervention state and support count. Reference and context unchanged.
selection: Max hits/216, then minimum exact-rational mean j/(2d+1) with unavailable/miss penalty 1, then larger lambda. No eligible calibration lambda or all-zero development detection => revision_required, no defaults. Failed calibration candidates retain all 216 planned blocked cases via roster and count.
sensitivity: Precompute .005/.02 cutoffs from the same ready calibration states; later retain selected model/lambda. No sensitivity performance or best-variant selection here.
preserved_final_design: B0/R/H, 7 families, 78 monthly variants, 936 cases, prescribed alpha and T range sensitivities remain required. This stage is statistical A3 tuning only, not final C4/C6 evaluation or integration into B0/R/H replay.
validation: Not executed here; next transfer unchanged to exposed 2023. Above .01 annual or .03 monthly FPR prompts diagnosis/disclosure, not automatic retuning.
completion: All candidate ledgers, rosters and decisions retained. Awaiting_validation is not scientific_freeze. No final intake or batch execution enabled.
recovery: Fresh directory per attempt; preserve failures, no partial resume for this bounded early stage. Researcher manually launches processing.
resources: Sequential variables/lambdas/pairs; 256 MiB available RAM and 1 GiB disk preflight are allowances, not guaranteed capacity. Scientific full-batch pilot remains pending.
